name: Blog
description: Write and publish a blog as Ravi Pages: one route per post under /blog, and an index page that lists them.

help.summary: Publish one post, or the /blog index page, as a route of the project's Ravi Page.
examples: ravi apps run blog publish --execute -- --route /blog/primeiro-post --title "Primeiro post" --body "<!doctype html>..."
ravi apps run blog publish --execute -- --route /blog --title "Blog" --body "<!doctype html>..."

sections.title: Rules
lines: One post is one route: /blog/<slug>, slug in lowercase-with-dashes.
After publishing a post, list posts and publish /blog again so the index links every post, newest first.
Publishing is a write: the router asks for --execute.
Pass the page as --body: the app is not allowed to read files.

help.summary: List the published routes; posts are the ones under /blog/.
Read a published post or the index back, to edit it or match its style.
